Statistics.title: Statistics

description: CIViC organizes curated cancer variant knowledge around variants and molecular profiles with evidence from source publications, summary assertions, and clinical context such as diseases, therapies, phenotypes, variant origins, and curating organizations. This schema describes a GA4GH GKS representation of those CIViC concepts. Top-level keys use CIViC knowledge model terms where possible, with additional keys for supporting GKS representation details. For the CIViC data model, see https://civic.readthedocs.io/en/latest/model.html.

sequenceReference.description: Reference sequences used by variant coordinates and HGVS expressions. Collection keys are refget sequence accessions.
sequenceReference.title: Sequencereference

location.description: Representative sequence locations for CIViC Variant coordinates. Collection keys are GA4GH SequenceLocation identifiers.
location.title: Location

variant.description: User-defined genomic alterations or related molecular events with potential clinical relevance. Collection keys are CIViC Variant IDs.

protein.description: HGVS protein expressions and other protein-level representations.

coding.description: HGVS coding DNA expressions, usually relative to a transcript.

genomic.description: HGVS genomic expressions and representative genomic coordinates.

other.description: VRS representations that are not clearly protein, coding, or genomic.

unsupported.description: Original variant identifier and label used when current tooling cannot represent the variant using VRS.

variant.title: Variant

feature.description: Genes associated with CIViC Variants and Molecular Profiles. Collection keys are CIViC Gene IDs.
feature.title: Feature

molecularProfile.description: CIViC Molecular Profiles interpreted for clinical relevance; this export currently includes profiles with one CIViC Variant. Collection keys are CIViC Molecular Profile IDs.
molecularProfile.title: Molecularprofile

disease.description: Cancer types or subtypes associated with CIViC Evidence Items and Assertions. Collection keys are CIViC Disease IDs.
disease.title: Disease

phenotype.description: Symptoms or abnormalities from the Human Phenotype Ontology that add clinical context. Collection keys are CIViC Phenotype IDs.
phenotype.title: Phenotype

conditionSet.description: Disease and phenotype context grouped for reuse in GKS propositions. Collection keys are computed bundle-local condition set identifiers.
conditionSet.title: Conditionset

therapy.description: Drugs or treatment types associated with predictive Evidence Items and Assertions. Collection keys are CIViC Therapy IDs.
therapy.title: Therapy

therapyGroup.description: Groups of multiple therapies used in predictive interpretations. Collection keys are computed bundle-local therapy group identifiers.
therapyGroup.title: Therapygroup

variantOrigin.description: Presumed source of a variant in the study context, such as somatic, germline, unknown, or not applicable. Collection keys are computed identifiers based on CIViC variant origin codes.
variantOrigin.title: Variantorigin

source.description: Publications or abstracts cited as support for CIViC Evidence Items and Assertions. Collection keys are CIViC Source IDs or PubMed IDs.
source.title: Source

method.description: Curation or classification method used to produce a CIViC GKS Statement. Collection keys are CIViC curation method IDs, such as civic.method:2019.
method.title: Method

organization.description: CIViC organizations connected to assertion approvals or submissions. Collection keys are CIViC Organization IDs.
organization.title: Organization

proposition.description: Structured clinical interpretation evaluated by CIViC Evidence Items or Assertions. Collection keys are computed bundle-local proposition identifiers.
proposition.title: Proposition

evidence.description: Clinical evidence statements manually curated from a source publication. Collection keys are CIViC Evidence IDs.
evidence.title: Evidence

assertion.description: CIViC Assertions that summarize and classify evidence for a Molecular Profile in a disease context. Collection keys are CIViC Assertion IDs.
assertion.title: Assertion

metadata.description: Bundle format, version, creation, and collection summary information.

failedAssertionIds.description: CIViC Assertion IDs skipped because they could not be converted.
failedAssertionIds.title: Failedassertionids

errors.description: Export errors explaining why specific CIViC Assertions were skipped.
errors.title: Errors
